name: Storj DCS
tagline: Decentralized, end-to-end encrypted S3 storage with 25GB free tier and zero egress fees.

instructions.navBreadcrumb: Storj Satellite › Access › Create S3 Credentials
instructions.step1: Log in to your Storj Satellite dashboard and go to Access.
instructions.step2: Click 'Create S3 Credentials' with read and write permissions for your bucket.
instructions.step3: Enter your Bucket Name, Access Key ID, and Secret Access Key into Ocloud.
